test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Match the following:

 
 

 
 
**Formula**

 
 
 
**Name**

 
 
 

 
 
i.

 
 
 
CH₃COOH

 
 
 
a.

 
 
 
Methane

 
 
 

 
 
ii.

 
 
 
CHCl₃

 
 
 
b.

 
 
 
Ethanol

 
 
 

 
 
iii.

 
 
 
CH₃CH₂OH

 
 
 
c.

 
 
 
Acetic acid

 
 
 

 
 
iv.

 
 
 
CH₄

 
 
 
d.

 
 
 
Chloroform

options.text: i - a, ii - b, iii - c, iv - d
i - a, ii - c, iii - b, iv - d
i - c, ii - d, iii - a, iv - b
i - c, ii - d, iii - b, iv - a

solution:
The correct answer is *__**i - c, ii - d, iii - b, iv - a.**__*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CH₃COOH** is the chemical formula for **Acetic acid**. This is a common organic acid found in vinegar and is known for its sour taste and strong odor. Hence, i matches with c.
 
• **CHCl₃** is the chemical formula for **Chloroform**. It is a colorless, sweet-smelling organic compound that is used as a solvent and was once used as an anesthetic. Hence, ii matches with d.
 
• **CH₃CH₂OH** is the chemical formula for **Ethanol**. This is a type of alcohol found in alcoholic beverages and is also used as a fuel and in thermometers. Hence, iii matches with b.
 
• **CH₄** is the chemical formula for **Methane**. It is a simple hydrocarbon and the main component of natural gas, used as a fuel. Hence, iv matches with a.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Acetic Acid (CH₃COOH):**__

 __
 
• Acetic acid is used in the production of chemical compounds, as a solvent for inks, paints, and coatings, and in the food industry as a preservative and flavoring agent.
 
 
 
• **Chloroform (CHCl₃):**__
 __
 
• Chloroform is used in the production of refrigerants, as a solvent in the pharmaceutical industry, and in laboratories for various chemical reactions.
 
 
 
• **Ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH):**__
 __
 
• Ethanol is widely used in the manufacture of alcoholic beverages, as a solvent in the pharmaceutical and cosmetic industries, and as a fuel or fuel additive.
 
 
 
• **Methane (CH₄):**__
 
 
• Methane is an important fuel source, used for heating, electricity generation, and as a chemical feedstock in the production of various chemicals and materials.
